scope: Full Serpent algorithm article only; no completion claim for Serpent-0, DES, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation, key management, implementations or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 Serpent 这一种 128 位块、32 轮的 AES 候选 SP 网络：四个 32 位字、八个 4 位 S-box、bitslice 表示、线性变换 LT、1 位补齐到 256 位的密钥调度、33 个子密钥、NESSIE 三组已验证向量与迭代测试；不把 Serpent-0、DES、AES、其他 AES 候选者、工作模式或整个库并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the 128-bit-block, 32-round Serpent AES-candidate SP network: four 32-bit words, eight 4-bit S-boxes, the bitslice representation, the LT linear transformation, the key schedule that pads short keys to 256 bits with a 1 bit, 33 subkeys, and the three NESSIE verified vector sets with iterated tests. It does not absorb Serpent-0, DES, AES, the other AES candidates, modes of operation or the whole library.
